metadata.title: Open Pickleball Research Commons v0.2: Supporting Materials for Cumulative Pickleball Science
metadata.description: Versioned supporting package for the Current Opinion "Standardize Provenance Before Outcomes: A Research Commons for Cumulative Pickleball Science". Includes a proof-of-concept evidence-map seed, coding manual, candidate PR-MDS specification and dictionary, and a candidate field measurement protocol. The Evidence Map is AI-assisted, abstract-level, and single-coded; the candidate specifications are not established standards.
metadata.notes: Reserve the DOI before publication and insert it into the manuscript data-availability statement and reference list.
